description: This file defines the WorkspaceActivateForm class, which manages the activation of workspaces within Drupal's administrative interface, including form handling, access control, and user messaging.

classes.name: WorkspaceActivateForm
classes.description: Form class for activating a workspace, handling user confirmation, access control, and messaging within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting workspace manager and messenger services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Returns the confirmation question asking if the user wants to activate the specified workspace.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Provides a description for the activation action.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Returns URL to cancel the form and go back to the workspace collection.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, removing the #after_build callback for content entity forms.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions, adding a cancel button with dialog-cancel class.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, activating the workspace and providing user feedback.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to activate the workspace, considering current active workspace.
